case_name: Smt. Babita Bai vs Radheshyam Sharma
facts_of_case: The wife seeks maintenance pendente lite, as she has no independent source of income and is dependent on her parents. The husband operates a motor vehicle and cultivates land.

legal_principles.principle: The burden of maintenance during pendency of appeal lies with the respondent.
legal_principles.held: We have however not impressed with submission as it has no bearing on an application under section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: The court may direct maintenance during pendency of appeal if the applicant has no independent source of income.
legal_principles.held: After considering the rival submissions and the fact that the appellant has no independent source of income for her livelihood...

outcome.final_order: The respondent was directed to pay the appellant Rs.5,000/- per month for maintenance during pendency of the appeal. The respondent was also prohibited from solemnizing a second marriage, as he had not done so already.

use_for_drafting: drafting maintenance applications in divorce cases
advising on pendency of appeal and maintenance rights
assisting with nullity of marriage proceedings
